candidates.statement: Uses WeChat as his primary IM app because it is very simple and straightforward and the most popular app in China.

evidence_candidates.quote: Well, it's because it's very simple and a very straightforward app. And it's an app that most popular in China.

candidates.statement: Uses WeChat because everybody around him uses it (Matthews effect), so he has to use the same app.

evidence_candidates.quote: So it's almost my case for me to use this app because everybody around me is using wechat. So I have to use it.

candidates.statement: Finds friends and family by typing their name in the search bar at the top of the screen (app UI walkthrough description).

evidence_candidates.quote: So when I open wechat you will see a search bar on top of the screen where you could type some name of your friends or your families where you could find you could find them.

candidates.statement: Could post his photos or updates in the Discover tab so that friends opening the tab can see his story (described social feature).

evidence_candidates.quote: So, for example, I could post my photos or something new with myself, and when I post it here, other friends could just open this tab, and they could show my story or something else.

candidates.statement: Uses WeChat mainly to communicate with his friends and family.

evidence_candidates.quote: Okay, so the main goal for me to use Wechat is just communicating with my friends and family.

candidates.statement: Sends a message to a colleague by searching his name at the search bar at the top of the screen, opening a private chat or group chat, and then typing and sending the message.

evidence_candidates.quote: And when I'm going to send a message to my colleague. Of course, I will 1st know his name. Yeah, so I could search him at the search bar at the top of screen, and then his contact entry will pop up and along with some groups where he's in, so I could choose to open a private chat or group chat and then type in my messages and simply send it.

candidates.statement: Tries to manage his chat box in WeChat but has nothing he can do with it and no idea how to manage it (WeChat has no channel concept, only private and group chats).
context: 微信无频道概念，仅私聊与群聊

evidence_candidates.quote: So when I'm trying to managing my chat box, I actually, I don't have anything could do with the chat box. I could just leave it there, and I have no idea how I could manage it.
Well, actually, wechat that's very bad at managing messages. Well, it doesn't have the Channel concept.

candidates.statement: Pins the chats he cares about (e.g., the chat box with his girlfriend, some groups) to the top of the chat list so they are the first chat boxes he sees whenever he opens WeChat.

evidence_candidates.quote: For example, I could ping the chat box with my girlfriends, or some groups that I care about at the top of the list of the chats, so whenever I open. We chat. The 1st the 1st chat box I could see is my girlfriend, or some groups.

candidates.statement: Pins the friends and families he cares most about to the top of the screen.

evidence_candidates.quote: Yeah, it's simply because that I wanna they are the friends or, yeah, they are friends or families that I cares most about. So I'll just ping them at top of the screen.

candidates.statement: Searches for specific messages by typing keywords at the top search bar, so all relevant messages pop up no matter whether they are in a group chat or a private chat.

evidence_candidates.quote: So I will simply type the messages at the top of the screen. Where is the search bar and all the relevant messages, no matter with whom. No matter, it's a group chat or a private chat will just simply pop up.

candidates.statement: Searches for messages with a certain person by going to the chat interface and touching an additional settings button, retrieving messages just between him and the one he is chatting with.

evidence_candidates.quote: And what's more, if I just want to search some messages with a certain someone, I can go to the chat interface and touch a additional settings button where I could search for messages that just between me and the one that I'm chatting with.

candidates.statement: Uses a chat's additional settings (3-dot icon) to type a search term (e.g., apple) so all relevant messages pop up, and can even search for images containing the term.

evidence_candidates.quote: For example, I type apple, and then all the messages relevant with apple will pop up, and I could even search for image that just with apple in it.

candidates.statement: Uses the payment system as the most useful feature: binds his credit or debit card and transfers money to friends or a merchant like a restaurant, paying by WeChat when going out.

evidence_candidates.quote: So Wechat actually combines some financial features where you could bind your credit card or debit card and transfer your money to your friends or a merchant like a restaurant. So when we are going out and buy something we could just pay by wechat.
It's so convenient that everyone in China never bring cash or card with themselves.

candidates.statement: Pays via the payment entrances (plus button on the chat tab or the Me tab): shows a QR code for the merchant or friend to scan, confirms the amount, authenticates with face ID or fingerprint, and the money is transferred.

evidence_candidates.quote: The merchant or my friend could scan the QR code, and I could confirm that I going to transfer some kind of money some amount of money like $100 to him

candidates.statement: Makes a payment either by scanning the other party's QR code or by showing his own QR code for the merchant to scan; both ways transfer money to the counterparty.

evidence_candidates.quote: You could scan others. QR code to make a payment. And actually, on the other hand, you could show your QR. Code, and for the merchant to scan you

candidates.statement: Searches for a certain image by typing text keywords (e.g., credit card) in the chat box so all images containing it show up, e.g., to find a card number.

evidence_candidates.quote: So sometimes I want to search for a card like a credit card and look for the card number, and I will go to the chat box and I will search credit card, and it will show up all the images that have a credit card in it.

candidates.statement: Retrieves a previously sent image (e.g., a credit card photo sent about 20 days earlier) by simply typing the keyword instead of scrolling back through the chat history.

evidence_candidates.quote: So if if without this feature, I have to scroll up to the certain day like 20 days before, and look for the picture. But I could hit now, but now I could just simply type credit card, and it will show up the messages with that credit card.

candidates.statement: Transfers files to friends; WeChat limits the size of files to be transferred to about 25 MB, so he has to save larger files on a cloud drive and send the download link instead.
context: 微信限制可传输文件大小约 25MB

evidence_candidates.quote: sometimes I need to transfer some files to my friends, yeah, it's another common scenarios.

And but wechat will limits the size of the file to be transferred like, I couldn't remember. Well, but it's gonna be 25, a million bytes. Yeah. 25 MB, so I have to save my file on some cloud drive and send a link to my friends for them to download the file.

candidates.statement: Keeps all his messages when changing phones: WeChat stores no messages in the cloud, so he has to manually transfer all messages to the new phone, which is very time-consuming.
context: 微信因隐私或存储成本不在云端存储消息，全部消息在手机本地

evidence_candidates.quote: So whenever I have to change my phone, for example, I buy a new phone. Yeah, I have to manually and transfer all the messages to a new phone.
Maybe for some concerns of privacy or cost of storage wechat will not store. We will not store any messages on clock, so which means that all the messages are on your phone.

candidates.statement: Avoids losing all his messages if his phone is lost (they would be gone and could never be recovered).

evidence_candidates.quote: Would say that as long as you lose your phone all the messages are gone and you could never back.

candidates.statement: Wants cloud storage for all his messages so they are available all the time; local messages occupy much of his iPhone storage, and with cloud support he could save space and no longer worry when changing phones.

evidence_candidates.quote: I would say the most important one would be the cloud storage for all the messages. Yeah, I wanna keep all my messages available all the time, but it just occupies much of my iphone storage, and so if we just supports this feature, I could save my space, and I don't need to worry anymore when I change my phone.
